summary: Source review only; deployed rules and project IAM were not verified. Existing rules use trusted claims, owner-only team grants and private-profile ownership. This patch closes removed-player submission and review-attribution gaps. Operational protections still require Firebase project access.

findings.issue: Removed players could create level submissions. Fixed in proposed rules.
findings.recommendation: Deploy and run the added removed-player denial test.

findings.issue: Level review updates lacked enforced reviewer identity and timestamps, and allowed repeated review. Fixed in proposed rules.
findings.recommendation: Deploy and run the added review forgery and repeated-review denial tests.

findings.issue: Authenticated users can submit multiple separate pending entries; schema bounds do not provide per-user rate limiting.
findings.recommendation: For sustained abuse, move submission creation behind a rate-limited trusted endpoint and integrate App Check after assessing legitimate clients.

findings.issue: Public level and approved record schemas permit additional moderator-written fields. This is not a member privilege escalation but can expose accidentally stored sensitive fields.
findings.recommendation: Audit existing legacy fields before introducing compatible allowlists; keep private information out of public documents.
